description: This is a shell script that contains tests and setup instructions for git submodule branch operations, including branch creation, tracking, and integration with submodules. It defines functions for resetting test environments and various tests for git submodule branch behaviors.

methods.name: reset_test
methods.description: Resets the test environment by removing specific directories and copying test setup from 'test_dirs'.

methods.name: test_no_branch
methods.description: Checks that a specific branch does not exist in a given directory, expecting failure.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test expecting success with a given description.

methods.name: reset_remote_test
methods.description: Resets the environment for remote-related tests, including removing cloned repositories.
